data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures, the fragrance of flowers or scents is often associated with the concept of paradise. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, “The way to the Garden is through love, through purifying one's self, and through wheat, dates, and coffee”. This was interpreted to mean that the entrance to paradise is in its beautiful fragrance, a beautiful garden filled with enchanting and soothing scents. Hence, the name Suhayma, meaning fragrant, can be seen as having deep spiritual significance, evoking the fragrance of paradise and reminding us of the eternal beauty and serenity awaiting us in the hereafter.
